_comment: Copy to distribute.config.json (gitignored), set absolute dest paths, run: node scripts/distribute.mjs
_lanes_comment: Lanes are a HOST property: every integrator lane this host runs, declared once. Each target with an integratorDest gets lanes.json + ONE supervisor (run_daemon.bat <lane>) beside its bundle; each lane's token/stop.flag/logs live in lanes/<lane>/. name: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$; resource defaults to 'main', pmUrl to 'http://localhost:3000'; env: extra variables for that lane's daemon (and so its verify children), never PM_API_TOKEN or PM_INTEGRATOR_LOG_FILE.
_targets_comment: A target receives any subset of mcpDest, integratorDest, docsDest, workerDocDest. A deploy directory outside every repo needs only integratorDest.
